skill.summary: Turn one piece of content into 10+ formats. Transform blog posts, podcasts, videos, or talks into tweets, LinkedIn posts, newsletters, carousels, and more.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Content Repurposer.

- Transform any single piece of content into 10+ formats, including threads, posts, carousels, scripts, outlines, and more.
- Repurposing Matrix: Covers Twitter/X threads, LinkedIn posts, Instagram carousels, newsletters, video scripts, blog outlines, quote graphics, email sequences, podcast points, and YouTube descriptions.
- Platform-native approach ensures each format fits its respective audience and style conventions.
- Built-in rules for hooks, CTA variation, and standalone value in every output.
- Flexible input handling: Works with blogs, transcripts, slides, notes, or even a single idea.
